newsitem.title: UK: It's the beer, stupid - Drinkers vote on UK poll.
newsitem.headline: It's the beer, stupid - Drinkers vote on UK poll.

text.p: Labour leader Tony Blair is favourite to win Thursday's elections in a poll that asks British beer drinkers to put their money where their vote is.

A central London pub, the Marquis of Granby, is dispensing specially-brewed beer from three pumps, each bearing the name of one of the main party leaders and a tally is being kept of the number of pints sold.
So far Tony Blair with 1,087 is just ahead of Liberal Democrat leader Paddy Ashdown on 1,017 and Conservative Prime Minister John Major on 829.
The latest Reuters/NOP opinion poll puts Labour on 50 percent, the Conservatives on 28 and the Liberal Ddemocrats on 14 percent.
